Beriberi.et: Late 17th century, from Dutch berebery (1612), beriberij (1631), possibly through French béribéri (1665). The Dutch is either from Portuguese berebere (1568) or directly from a language of Southeast Asia. The ultimate origin is usually identified as Sinhalese …

s: mounted police
reportative formulation (a set phrase which is used to report something (i.e. tell of something which the speaker did not experience firsthand), e.g. a story, a quotation, etc.)
Die hiſtoriſche Berichtsformel: ἐὰν εἴπῃ ὁ ποὺς, wenn der Fus ſpraͤche.
The historical reporting formula: ἐὰν εἴπῃ ὁ ποὺς, when the foot would speak.
Es folgen die Verse von den Schwestern Phaethons, Verse, bei denen, wie bereits bemerkt, jedwede Berichtsformel fehlt.

report formula (a set phrase used in official documents)
Switzerland
34 derselben bedienen sich kurz und trocken ungefähr der Berichtsformel: „Wir machen Ihnen die Mittheilung, die unter die Kategorie der Verwahrlosten gezählt werden dürfen[“].
34 of them briefly and dryly use approximately the following reporting formula: “We are informing you of something that may be classified as neglected.”
Ebenſo iſt es abzulehnen, den Gewinn zu Abſchreibungen zu verwenden, obwohl es gar keine ſo ſeltene Berichtsformel der beſchließenden Jahresverſammlung iſt.
It is also unacceptable to use profits for depreciation, even though this is not an uncommon reporting formula at the annual general meeting.
Berichtsformel.et: From Bericht + -s- + Formel. First attested in 1761 by Siegmund Jakob Baumgarten.
